ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: When the data generator supports data generator-calculated split cost allocation, column conforming to DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllocationHandling attribute MUST adhere to the following requirements:

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator-Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: *FOCUS dataset column* values in *allocated charges* MUST match the corresponding value in the *origin charge* when the *FOCUS dataset column* represents a dimension.

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator-Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: *FOCUS dataset column* values in *allocated charges* MUST match the corresponding value in the *origin charge* when the *FOCUS dataset column* represents a non-summable *metric* (e.g., unit prices).

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator-Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: The sum of *FOCUS dataset column* values in *allocated charges* MUST match the corresponding value in the *origin charge* when the *FOCUS dataset column* represents a summable *metric* (e.g., costs and quantities).
